verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships first-party versioning and review capabilities. Automations are code in standard languages, and Pulumi maintains its own GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations. `pulumi preview` shows proposed changes without applying them, and policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks. The pack has no evidence of a rollback capability such as stack history, reverting to a prior deployment, or undo. Missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of deployed changes, explicit deployment version history, independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
